start.title: Share your screen
start.intro: Pick the quality first. Next, your system asks which window or screen to share.
start.resolutionAutoHint: Auto adapts to your upload and your viewers
start.optimizeSharpHint: Code, slides, documents: keeps the resolution, lowers the frame rate first
start.optimizeSmoothHint: Games, video: keeps the frame rate, lowers the resolution first
start.codecHintCpu: Uses the processor: about {{used}} of {{total}} cores. With an AV1 graphics card: AV1 (GPU), almost no CPU.
start.codecHintGpu: Uses your graphics card, so sharing costs almost no CPU.
start.av1SoftwareLimit: AV1 in software is limited to 1080p30 on this PC
start.pathRelay: Sent once through the server's relay, which passes it on to up to {{count}} viewers.
start.pathDirect: One copy per viewer, up to {{count}}.
start.olderMumcord: Viewers on an older Mumcord get VP9.

qualityMenu.title: Quality
qualityMenu.note: Changes apply within a second, without restarting the share.

notices.noFanoutTitle: This server has no relay for large shares
notices.noFanoutBody_one: Each viewer gets their own copy from your computer, so up to {{max}} people can watch. Quality goes down as more join: right now {{count}} viewer needs about {{mbit}} Mbit/s of upload, so your share runs at {{now}} instead of {{wanted}}.

notices.fanoutUnavailable: Relay fan-out isn't available ({{reason}}). Each viewer gets their own copy, so up to {{max}} can watch and quality may drop.
notices.reasonDisallowed: the relay doesn't allow screen sharing
notices.encoderTitle: Your computer couldn't keep up with {{from}} — switched to {{to}} to keep the share smooth
notices.encoderBody: Encoding on the processor (SVT-AV1) took too long and frames were dropped. Your share stays at {{quality}} with {{to}}, which needs less CPU. Viewers saw a short refresh, nothing else.

settings.title: Screen sharing
settings.intro: Quality, codec and hardware for sharing your screen. Viewers always see what you pick before you start.
settings.resolutionHint: Auto starts at the best quality your upload and your viewers allow, and steps down when they can't keep up.
settings.uploadHint: The most your share sends in total. Useful on a shared or metered connection.
settings.askEachTime: Ask for these settings each time I share
settings.codecAutoHint: AV1 on your graphics card first, then AV1 on the processor if a short check shows it keeps up, otherwise VP9. AV1 only when every viewer can play it.
settings.codecAv1Hint: Sharpest picture for the same data. Viewers who can't play it get VP9.
settings.codecVp9Hint: What Mumcord used so far. Works for every viewer.
settings.codecNoteCpu: Without a graphics card, AV1 uses the processor (SVT-AV1). Mumcord switches to VP9 if your computer can't keep up.
settings.codecNoteOlder: Viewers on an older Mumcord always get VP9, whatever you pick.
settings.useGpuHint: Encodes AV1 on your graphics card, so sharing costs almost no CPU. Off: AV1 uses the processor.
